solution: $\\sin2\\theta+\\sin3\\theta=2\\sin(\\tfrac{5\\theta}{2})\\cos(\\tfrac{\\theta}{2})=0$. So either $\\sin(\\tfrac{5\\theta}{2})=0\\Rightarrow \\tfrac{5\\theta}{2}=k\\pi\\Rightarrow \\theta=\\tfrac{2k\\pi}{5}$, or $\\cos(\\tfrac{\\theta}{2})=0\\Rightarrow \\theta=\\pi$. In $[0,\\pi]$ the solutions are $\\theta=0,\\ \\tfrac{2\\pi}{5},\\ \\tfrac{4\\pi}{5},\\ \\pi$ (the next $\\tfrac{6\\pi}{5}>\\pi$).
